capabilities: Write CVs in Markdown using a dedicated notation
Preview the CV as a PDF from the ribbon or command palette
Restrict preview to specific notes by path or tag
Adjust PDF text size and embed custom TTF/WOFF fonts
Insert page breaks after sections or individual items
extras: The README defers the full CV Markdown format specification to the main monorepo repository's README.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn a Markdown note into a polished, consistently formatted PDF curriculum vitae.

relations.evidence: Consistent formatting with the web version.

summary: CV generator that renders Markdown notes into a formatted PDF resume with a live preview inside the vault.
